name: Fool's Stout

narrative.details:
So you want some Fool's Stout, eh?  Thinking of heading back to the races...?

All right, bring me more of Zanzil's mixture and I'll make some more stout for you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 12 of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, very good! Here is your pay.And here is a little something extra... for your discretion.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have those Zanzil mixtures yet, adventurer?
